verdict.rationale: Twilio documents Phone Numbers APIs to search for and buy numbers, plus a Regulatory Compliance API for building Regulatory Bundles, so number provisioning with a compliance workflow is its own capability. Nothing in the pack shows per-country requirements being surfaced up front, and one user reports that getting numbers in Germany was so restrictive they abandoned it. Missing for 10: evidence of multi-country number inventory, a per-country listing of documentation requirements shown before purchase, and hands-on corroboration of international provisioning.
